name: Ship (checks and approval, then your deploy)
description: The gate to go live: everything merged, quality gate green, queue empty, then a human says yes. Copy docs/examples/scenarios/cloudflare-ship.json into your scenarios folder to add real Cloudflare DNS and Pages steps, or add your own.
